CommunityApplications.Profile:
KEIBISOFT makes KEIBIDROP, an end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer app that opens another computer's folder over the internet as if it were on your own disk. This repository holds the Unraid template for the KEIBIDROP serving peer: your Unraid box serves a folder, and your computer opens it on demand with the KEIBIDROP desktop app on macOS, Windows or Linux.
Website: https://keibidrop.com Source code and support: https://github.com/KeibiSoft/KeibiDrop/issues NAS guide: https://keibidrop.com/docs/how-to/run-on-a-nas.html
